greeting: The day is yours, Dan — one bright fixed point at noon and clear water on either side of it. Good morning from Portland.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV won't wait
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority board task has been open since Sept 14: book a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week. With the Pathfinder heading south, it's the only six-seater for the girls in Maine, and holiday inventory sells out.

needsAttention.title: December break — decide and book
needsAttention.detail: The shortlist was due Sept 30 and the booking window closes Oct 15 — five days out. Six people over three weeks of holiday is the thinnest inventory of the year; pick domestic-default or refundable-international and commit.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south is open
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 gap between girl-weeks is the window to drive the Pathfinder Portland → St Pete. It's open right now and replaces a flight rather than adding a trip; set dates and book the one hotel night.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike at 9
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's 15-minute board review is where the Christmas rental, December break, and Pathfinder items get owners, dates, and a chase. Arrive knowing which of these you'll move this week.

needsAttention.title: Term life quotes for Mike
needsAttention.detail: A p2 board task open since Sept 25: shop three term life quotes — length and coverage — so Mike only has to do the application and exam. Still missing a target coverage amount and term to price against.

flagged.title: Fran's waiting on where to meet
flagged.detail: Lunch is set for next Friday 12:30; Fran replied that cooked sushi works, so it's just on you to confirm the spot (you'd floated Miyake and Isa Bistro).
